scope.title: Structural & Stratigraphic Framework Modelling
scope.description: Construction of a fit-for-purpose 3D structural-stratigraphic geocellular model integrating available well log, core, and seismic data, with petrophysical property population and volumetric estimation.
scope: Well data compilation, QC, and normalization (logs, deviation surveys, tops)
Correlation framework: marker picking, zonation, net-pay cut-off analysis
Seismic-to-well tie and horizon interpretation (where data available)
Structural modelling: fault network, pillar gridding, layering scheme
Facies modelling (SIS or object-based) and petrophysical property population
Model upscaling and static volumetrics (STOIIP/GIIP) with P10/P50/P90 range

scales.scopeNote: single reservoir interval, basic deterministic model
multi-zone field model with facies modelling
multi-reservoir model, geostatistical workflows, full uncertainty

timeline.desc: Project kick-off, data request and receipt, preliminary QC.
Well log processing, correlation framework, seismic interpretation.
Geocellular model construction, property population, volumetric computation.

addons.name: Fault seal analysis
addons.desc: Pressure regime and trap integrity assessment
